Strength.name: Strength
Strength.description: Raw physical power. Determines melee damage, carrying capacity, and feats of brute force.

Dexterity.name: Dexterity
Dexterity.description: Agility and reflexes. Affects ranged attacks, evasion, and fine motor tasks.

Constitution.name: Constitution
Constitution.description: Physical resilience. Governs hit points, poison resistance, and staying power under injury.

Intelligence.name: Intelligence
Intelligence.description: Mental acuity and knowledge. Key for spellcasting, lore, and analytical reasoning.

Wisdom.name: Wisdom
Wisdom.description: Awareness and intuition. Affects perception, healing, and reading situations.

Charisma.name: Charisma
Charisma.description: Strength of personality. Governs social influence, mental fortitude, and willpower.

Focus.name: Focus
Focus.description: An example of a separate 'special' attribute with no skills of its own, capped independently of the six core stats. Repurpose it for whatever your setting needs - magical attunement, initiative, sanity, luck - or remove it if six attributes are enough.

Athletics.name: Athletics
Athletics.description: Climbing, jumping, swimming, and other physical feats of endurance and coordination.

Might.name: Might
Might.description: Brute force for breaking objects, grappling, and overpowering opponents.

Unarmed.name: Unarmed
Unarmed.description: Fighting without weapons. Determines punch damage and grapple effectiveness.

Endurance.name: Endurance
Endurance.description: Stamina for sustained physical activity, long marches, and resisting exhaustion.

Acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
Acrobatics.description: Balance, tumbling, and nimble maneuvers in and out of combat.

Sleight of Hand.name: Sleight of Hand
Sleight of Hand.description: Pickpocketing, lockpicking, and subtle manual tricks.

Stealth.name: Stealth
Stealth.description: Moving silently and staying hidden from enemies.

Grit.name: Grit
Grit.description: Extra resilience when wounded. Provides a combat bonus when your HP is low.

Resistance.name: Resistance
Resistance.description: Resistance to poison, disease, and environmental hazards.

Arcana.name: Arcana
Arcana.description: Knowledge of magical theory, spells, enchantments, and arcane lore.

History.name: History
History.description: Recall of historical events, lineages, and ancient civilizations.

Investigation.name: Investigation
Investigation.description: Searching for clues, deducing conclusions, and solving puzzles.

Nature.name: Nature
Nature.description: Knowledge of plants, animals, terrain, and natural phenomena.

Religion.name: Religion
Religion.description: Understanding of deities, rites, religious symbols, and divine lore.

Luck.name: Luck
Luck.description: Chance-based fortune. Influences random encounters and fortunate outcomes.

Animal Handling.name: Animal Handling
Animal Handling.description: Calming, training, and communicating with animals.

Insight.name: Insight
Insight.description: Reading body language and intentions. Detects lies and hidden motives.

Medicine.name: Medicine
Medicine.description: Treating wounds, diagnosing illness, and stabilizing the dying.

Perception.name: Perception
Perception.description: Noticing hidden details, spotting traps, and general environmental awareness.

Survival.name: Survival
Survival.description: Tracking, foraging, navigating wilderness, and enduring harsh conditions.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Lying convincingly, disguising intentions, and misleading others.

Intimidation.name: Intimidation
Intimidation.description: Coercing through threats, physical presence, or sheer willpower.

Performance.name: Performance
Performance.description: Entertaining, acting, storytelling, and captivating an audience.

Persuasion.name: Persuasion
Persuasion.description: Influencing others through diplomacy, charm, and reasoned argument.
